# 🥷 Kiriko – Round 1 Strategy Guide

## 🔮 Core Focus: Healing & Cash Generation
Round 1 plays like classic mode. Kiriko should focus on **healing consistently** using her **Futa**, while also trying to **deal some damage** to contribute to eliminations.

 💡 *Tip: Stay active in fights to maximize your cash for Round 2 upgrades.*

---

## 💰 Starting Cash: 3,500
With this fixed amount, no purchasing decisions are needed. The goal is simple: **heal**, **survive**, and **generate as much cash as possible** to unlock powerful skills in Round 2.

---

## 🎯 Round Priorities

| 🎮 Key Actions         | 🎯 Objective                    |
|------------------------|--------------------------------|
| Heal with Futa         | Consistent team support        |
| Deal damage            | Boost cash generation          |
| Stay alive             | Win the round  |

---

## 🧠 Bonus Tip
Avoid overextending for solo kills. Your role is to **support your team** and **set up your build** for the upcoming rounds.

---

# 🥷 Kiriko – Round 2 Strategy Guide

## 🔮 Core Focus: Healing & Team Sustain
Round 2 is all about **sustain** and **area control**. Kiriko shines here thanks to her healing output and mobility tools.

 💡 *Tip: Stay close to your teammates to maximize healing and utility impact.*

---

## 💰 Cash Management: What to Buy

### 🔹 If you have **more than 10k cash**:
- Prioritize  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) .
- Complement it with  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56)  and **Green** skills
### 🔸 If you have **less than 10k cash**:
- Invest in  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) and **Green** skills.

---

## 🍩 Why  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b)  Is So Powerful
- It dramatically increases your **healing output**.
- It helps your team survive longer, especially during extended engagements.
- It have a great synergy with  [Clone Conjuration](item_6c9f6be1-ab29-4f46-af24-34e4835f9af3) 

---

| 💵 Cash Available | 🛠️ Recommended Skill(s)           | 🎯 Role / Benefit           |
|------------------|------------------------------------|-----------------------------|
| 10k+            |  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b)  + (optional )[Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56)  + (optional)Green      | High Healing / Support      |
| -10k            |  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) + Green                       | Moderate Healing / Utility  |

# 🥷 Kiriko – Round 3 Strategy Guide

## 🔮 Core Combo:  [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b)  +   [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) 
The [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b), when combined with [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718), offers powerful overhealth. This combo is ideal for absorbing burst damage and surviving enemy ultimates.

 💡 *Tip: Use the combo proactively when anticipating heavy pressure or team fights.*

---

## 💰 Cash Management: What to Buy Based on Your Budget

### 🔹 If you have **less than 21k cash**:
- Go for the  [Goddess's Aura](item_a36d46c8-cee0-4c97-b6e4-72bb816c13dc)  skill.
- It provides excellent **mobility** and helps you escape dangerous situations or reposition quickly.

### 🔸 If you have **less than 20k cash**:
- You can purchase  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56)  and **Green** skills.

---

## 🍩 Why  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) Is a Game-Changer
- It significantly boosts your **healing potential**, especially in clustered team fights.
- It synergizes with your  [Clone Conjuration](item_6c9f6be1-ab29-4f46-af24-34e4835f9af3), allowing you to **maintain pressure** while keeping allies alive.

---

# 🥷 Kiriko – Round 4 Strategy Guide

## 🔮 Core Focus: Damage Reduction + Massive Healing
Round 4 is a pivotal moment. Kiriko reaches her **power spike** with three key skills:  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) ,  [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718), and  [Goddess's Aura](item_a36d46c8-cee0-4c97-b6e4-72bb816c13dc).

 💡 *Tip: Prioritize survivability and teamfight impact above all.*

---

## 💰 Recommended Total Budget: 31,000

### 🛠️ Skills to Purchase:
- ✅ **Top Priority**:  
  -  [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) for Critical damage reduction  
  -  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) for Massive healing and sustain

- ✅ **Optional if budget allows**:  
  -  [Goddess's Aura](item_a36d46c8-cee0-4c97-b6e4-72bb816c13dc)  will increse your survivability
  - *If short on cash*, buy with  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) or **Green**

---

## 🍩 Why This Trio Works So Well
-  [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) helps absorb ultimates and burst damage.
-  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) keeps your team alive during extended fights.
-  [Goddess's Aura](item_a36d46c8-cee0-4c97-b6e4-72bb816c13dc) gives you a quick escape or repositioning tool.

---

## 🎯 Quick Reference Table

| 💵 Target Budget | 🛠️ Recommended Skill(s)                    | 🎯 Role / Benefit               |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|
| 31k+             |  [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) +  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) +  [Goddess's Aura](item_a36d46c8-cee0-4c97-b6e4-72bb816c13dc) + (optional) [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56)/Green  | Overhealth / Heal / survivability |
| -31k            |  [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) +  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b)  +  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) + (optional)Green          | Overhealth / Heal   |

---

## 🧠 Bonus Tip
If you must choose, **never skip Suzu Shield or Donut Delivery**. They are the foundation of your Round 4 effectiveness.

# 🥷 Kiriko – Round 5 Strategy Guide

## 🔮 Abilities: Strategic Choice for Round 5
By Round 5, you already have the three core upgrades:
- ✅  [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) 
- ✅  [Talisman of Life](item_7ecfd3eb-d869-41fe-87eb-0bb2e82e5718) 
- ✅  [Goddess's Aura](item_a36d46c8-cee0-4c97-b6e4-72bb816c13dc) 

Now it's time to choose **one new ability**. Two strong options depending on the enemy and team setup:

### 🛠️ Ability Options:

- 🎯  [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198) 
  → Boosts your team’s **average DPS**. Ideal if your team lacks damage or plays aggressively.

- 🧼  [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68) 
  → Helps **charge your ultimate faster**. Only worth picking if enemies apply **frequent negative effects** (e.g.  [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54),  [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000),  [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1)).

---

### 🎯 Recommended Abilities Table

| 🧠 Game Situation                       | ✅ Recommended Ability     | 🎯 Role / Benefit                    |
|----------------------------------------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| Team has average DPS                   |  [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198)          | Boost team damage                    |
| Enemies apply frequent debuffs         |  [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68)           | Faster ultimate charge               |
